_: DERIVED — written by node tools/manifest.mjs --write in cehinds/AshenSpire-art, never by a hand. One entry per asset id (the runtime `assets/…` path, or a `common` pack path: fonts, licenses/OFL.txt, music/, map-detail/). Each record's path is where the file sits in its pack's zip.

tiers.placeholder: no file: the game draws the style guide recipe from the id
tiers.light: assets-mobile/ in light-assets-v<N>.zip (light/assets/ in cehinds/AshenSpire-art, generated from hd/assets/ by tools/mobile-art.mjs) — the dev/test tier
tiers.high: assets/ in hd-assets-v<N>.zip (hd/assets/ in cehinds/AshenSpire-art) — full resolution; release/main builds and the Local high-res setting
tiers.common: common-assets-v<N>.zip (common/ in cehinds/AshenSpire-art) — one file for every tier: assets/fonts/ (the fonts), licenses/OFL.txt, music/ and map-detail/
